caption: The video showcases a tall lattice tower built from green hollow rectangular blocks, standing upright at the center of a light wooden floor surrounded by scattered red, blue, and green loose blocks. The tower remains centered and vertical throughout, while its outer blocks progressively peel away and tumble downward. On the right face, pieces tilt and fall with motion blur, dropping into the green mound at the tower's base. A vertical streak of detaching green pieces then runs down the front-center face, while the left edge grows ragged as blocks slip off in turn. The surrounding red and blue piles stay essentially undisturbed, and a white shoe is visible at the top-right edge as the erosion continues. The structure does not topple; it steadily loses its outer layer while holding its overall height and position.
relations: Green outer blocks loosen from faces and tumble into the green base mound.
Tower stays centered and upright while its outer layer peels away.
Right-face pieces tilt and fall with motion blur; front-center pieces streak downward.
Left-edge blocks slip off, while red and blue piles remain undisturbed.
